english_evidence: No source mentions English/Engelse rijles. Aggregator autorijschooltarieven.nl lists language as 'Nederlands' only; school's stated specialisms are autism/ADHD and faalangst (Dutch-language special-needs instruction), not expat/English lessons.
price_signal: Personenauto €45,50/uur; Motor €46,50/uur; Auto+aanhanger €51/uur (autorijschooltarieven.nl). EduCar calculator default ~€60/les.
notes: Founded 1991 (explicit on vlijmen4you.nl 'Vanaf 1991' and confirmed by baxopleidingen.nl press release 'opgericht in 1991'). Per 1 augustus 2025 acquired by Bax Opleidingen but continues to operate under the name 'Verkeersschool Bakker' with the same instructors and CBR rijschoolnummer 0318X8 (Den Bosch exam location). Special-needs focus: autism/ADHD lessons (www.autisme-adhd-rijles.nl) and faalangst (test-anxiety) instruction. Offers RIS, driving simulator, spoedopleidingen. Both manual (RIS standard) and automaat lessons confirmed. Address: current ops at Parallelweg-West 54D 5251JG (CBR/aggregators); older/secondary listing Plein 5a 5251AS. CBR official aantal eerste examens (auto) 109, slagingspercentage 59%. No English-instruction evidence found; not positioned for expats. KvK shown as 559569980000 on aggregator is the 8-digit 55956998 plus vestiging suffix.
